"""RoboPaint rcb-limited/2.2 episode controller for the 'unpin' exemplar.
All positions in world metres; image paths are extracted from the public target.
"""
import sys, math, pathlib, json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
Q0 = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])

def q_nib(alpha=0.0):
    # Rz(alpha) Rx(pi): nib edge has the desired in-plane bearing.
    return np.array([0., math.cos(alpha/2), math.sin(alpha/2), 0.])

def interp_pose_path(points, step=0.003):
    """Resample [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] waypoints to short straight target intervals."""
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(points[:-1], points[1:]):
        a=np.asarray(a,float); b=np.asarray(b,float)
        d=np.linalg.norm(b[:3]-a[:3])
        n=max(1,int(math.ceil(d/step)))
        for k in range(1,n+1):
            t=k/n
            q=(1-t)*a[3:]+t*b[3:]
            q/=np.linalg.norm(q)
            out.append(np.r_[(1-t)*a[:3]+t*b[:3],q])
    if not out: out=[np.asarray(points[-1],float)]
    return np.asarray(out,dtype=np.float32)

def submit_path(r, points, note, step=0.003, video='none', cameras=None):
    actions=interp_pose_path(points,step)
    reports=[]
    for i in range(0,len(actions),180):
        res=r.submit('ee_pose',actions[i:i+180],dt=DT,video=video,
                     cameras=cameras,note=note)
        reports.append(res.meta)
        if res.meta.get('plan'):
            fails=[p for p in res.meta['plan'] if isinstance(p,dict) and p.get('ik_fail')]
            if fails: print('IK_FAIL',note,fails[:4])
    return reports

def pose(x,y,z,q=Q0): return np.r_[x,y,z,q]

def init_and_practice():
    r=Robot()
    start=np.asarray(r.get_obs(video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float)
    # Center of the ink well is on the +y side of the main paper.
    q=Q0
    submit_path(r,[start,pose(-.1,.15,.11,q)],'approach ink well')
    submit_path(r,[pose(-.1,.15,.11,q),pose(-.1,.15,.015,q)],'dip nib')
    hold=np.repeat(pose(-.1,.15,.015,q)[None,:],20,axis=0)
    r.submit('ee_pose',hold,dt=DT,video='none',note='ink dwell')
    submit_path(r,[pose(-.1,.15,.015,q),pose(-.1,.15,.10,q)],'lift from well')
    # Practice wide stroke: edge along world -y, path along world x.
    submit_path(r,[pose(-.1,.15,.10,q),pose(-.1,-.1856,.07,q),
                   pose(-.1,-.1856,.018,q),pose(-.08,-.1856,.018,q)],
                'practice broad mark',step=.0025)
    submit_path(r,[pose(-.08,-.1856,.018,q),pose(-.08,-.1856,.07,q),
                   pose(-.07,-.1956,.07,q),pose(-.07,-.1956,.018,q),
                   pose(-.07,-.1756,.018,q)],'practice hairline mark',step=.0025)
    submit_path(r,[pose(-.07,-.1756,.018,q),pose(-.07,-.1756,.08,q)],'lift practice nib')
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=['practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],video='none')
    pathlib.Path('/app/output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for c,img in o.last.items():Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/check_{c}.png')
    print('practice status',r.status())

if __name__=='__main__': init_and_practice()
